import http.server
import socketserver
import os

# Define the port

# Change to the directory containing our HTML file

# Create a simple HTTP request handler

# Create the server

    print(f"Server running at http://localhost:{PORT}/")
    print(f"Shopping site available at http://localhost:{PORT}/shopping_site.html")
    print("Press Ctrl+C to stop the server")

        httpd.serve_forever()
